name: ChromaDB
author: Mox Neo
description: Reusable Pterodactyl egg for ChromaDB. Runs a persistent Chroma server on the allocation port, stores vectors under /home/container/data, and prepares a local backup script under /home/container/scripts.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data /mnt/server/scripts /mnt/server/backups
cat > /mnt/server/scripts/chromadb-backup.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
STAMP="$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
OUT="/home/container/backups/chromadb-${STAMP}.tar.gz"
mkdir -p /home/container/backups
tar -C /home/container -czf "$OUT" data
echo "backup_created=$OUT"
EOF
chmod 0755 /mnt/server/scripts/chromadb-backup.sh
echo 'ChromaDB install prep complete.'
